title: Nineteen Eighty-Four
author: George Orwell
summary: In a country ruled by an all-seeing Party, a low-level clerk who rewrites the historical record begins to keep a secret diary. He starts an illicit affair, and both acts are crimes.
readIf: you want the defining novel about surveillance, propaganda and the control of truth.
skipIf: you want hope or catharsis, because the book is bleak and its last third is hard to read.

pairings.reason: The other great classic dystopia, where control comes from pleasure instead of fear.
A modern, intimate dystopia about a regime that controls bodies as well as language.
A much gentler, shorter story of a controlled society and a young person who begins to see through it.
